summary: This Form 6-K filed by Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. under Rule 13a-16 presents the final detailed voting map from its Extraordinary General Meeting held on July 2, 2026. The filing consolidates votes on seven items but does not disclose the nature of those items, nor does it indicate a transformative corporate event such as a merger, acquisition, or restructuring. This is a routine post-meeting report of shareholder voting results, not a special situation. It is analogous to a US proxy tabulation report. No deal terms are present, and there is no event to monitor.
